name: Pulse
source:
Pulse is a visual novel which leads the player through three meaningful moments of a life, allowing them to face them in many different ways. Our experiences will be crucial to define us as a unique person. Because even the smallest decisions matter in our lives.

[From [url=http://globalgamejam.org/2017/games/pulse-13]Global Game Jam[/url]]

Created for Global Game Jam 2017.
translation:
《Pulse》是一部视觉小说，引导玩家经历人生中三个有意义的时刻，并以许多不同方式面对它们。我们的经历将决定我们独一无二的身份，因为人生中即使最微小的决定也很重要。

（来源：[url=http://globalgamejam.org/2017/games/pulse-13]Global Game Jam[/url]）
